values.note: RV sites: 30-amp $50 a night plus a $3 utilities surcharge, 50-amp $55 plus $4.50; weekly $255/$275 and monthly $740/$825, each with its own utilities surcharge. 3% surcharge on card payments. Stalls and paddocks extra. The price sheet carries no date.

values.note: 26 RV sites, about 40 x 60 ft ('We can easily accommodate large trailers and motorhomes'), each with a picnic table and fire ring; also tent sites with water and 110V electric, 2 villas and a park model.

values.note: Public restroom and bath house; paid laundry; Wi-Fi throughout the ranch but service is limited near the forest. Clubhouse, fishing dock, dog parks; stalls, paddocks and riding arenas for horses.

values.note: Call 352-669-7111 or 352-707-7056 (or email). A one-night fee is held on daily reservations. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. All horses must be in a stall or paddock at night.

note: Equestrian RV ranch (formerly the U.S. Mounted Police training center) bordering the Ocala National Forest near Altoona, with trail access from the property; RVers without horses welcome. --Claude
summary: Operator pages: confirmed $50 (30A) / $55 (50A) nightly plus small utilities surcharges, 30/50-amp full hookups at all sites, 26 RV sites, phone reservations; added laundry/Wi-Fi. Not stated: max rig length (45 from the note, left), pull-throughs (left), dates on the price sheet.
